questions.question: Mina, now a national reference in pedodontics, is invited to an international congress. What message should she convey?
options: Pedodontics is a model of humanization of care
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Pedodontics is a model of humanization of care.' 🦅 Sami: 'I am proud of you.'
